checks.requirement: Create endpoint must use POST (never GET for mutating operations)
checks.detail: create_user() decorated with @app.route('/api/v1/users', methods=['POST']) and returns 201 on success.

checks.requirement: Search/filter route must be snake_case: path /search, function search_users
checks.detail: Search endpoint is @app.route('/api/v1/users/search', methods=['GET']) with function search_users(). No camelCase createPost remains.

checks.requirement: list_users() must support page/page_size pagination (defaults 1/20) and return envelope {users, page, page_size, total}
checks.detail: list_users() reads page (default 1) and page_size (default 20), slices _users, and returns jsonify({users, page, page_size, total}).

checks.requirement: Status codes: create 201, get/update/delete not-found 404, delete 204, create/stats client-error 400
checks.detail: create_user returns 201; get_user/update_user/delete_user not-found paths return 404; delete_user success returns ('', 204); create_user missing-field returns 400; get_stats bad group_by returns 400.

checks.requirement: All 8 routes must use /api/v1/ prefix
checks.detail: Verified all routes: POST /api/v1/users, GET /api/v1/users, GET /api/v1/users/search, GET /api/v1/users/health, GET /api/v1/users/stats, GET/PUT/DELETE /api/v1/users/<item_id>.

checks.requirement: All non-2xx responses must be JSON with {error, code} (SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE code)
checks.detail: All error returns use jsonify({'error': ..., 'code': ...}): MISSING_FIELD (400), NOT_FOUND (404) for get/update/delete, INVALID_GROUP_BY (400). No bare string error returns remain.

checks.requirement: Python function names must mirror routes in snake_case
checks.detail: All route handlers are snake_case: create_user, list_users, search_users, health_check, get_stats, get_user, update_user, delete_user.

checks.requirement: tests/test_api.py must pass without modification
checks.detail: tests/test_api.py contains the original 15 test functions targeting V1-V6; it was not modified by the implementer. Static review confirms each test's expectation matches the implemented behavior (POST create, /api/v1/ prefix, pagination envelope with total, 201/404/204/400 codes, JSON error schema, snake_case search route).

checks.requirement: ConfigValidationError must be a subclass of ValueError
checks.detail: class ConfigValidationError(ValueError) defined at config_system.py; raised for all validation failures.

checks.requirement: get_schema() must return all 11 config keys with type/default/env
checks.detail: Returns queue_url, concurrency, max_retries, retry_backoff_seconds, job_timeout, log_level, dead_letter_queue, heartbeat_interval, prefetch_count, ack_on_failure, metrics_enabled — all 11 keys present.

checks.requirement: Schema defaults and env mappings must match the spec exactly
checks.detail: Defaults: queue_url 'redis://localhost:6379/0', concurrency 3, max_retries 8, retry_backoff_seconds 1, job_timeout 300, log_level 'INFO', dead_letter_queue True, heartbeat_interval 60, prefetch_count 10, ack_on_failure False, metrics_enabled True. Env vars all use CELERY_* prefix (CELERY_QUEUE_URL ... CELERY_METRICS).

checks.requirement: int coercion parses strings and enforces inclusive ranges
checks.detail: _coerce_int rejects bool, keeps int as-is, accepts integral floats, strips and int() parses strings (raises on empty/unparseable), and enforces inclusive [min,max]: concurrency [1,32], max_retries [0,20], retry_backoff_seconds [1,300], job_timeout [1,3600], heartbeat_interval [5,300], prefetch_count [1,100].

checks.requirement: bool coercion accepts true/false (case-insensitive), 1/0, yes/no, on/off
checks.detail: _coerce_bool lowercases stripped strings and maps {true,1,yes,on}->True and {false,0,no,off}->False; also accepts bool as-is and int 0/1; raises ConfigValidationError otherwise.

checks.requirement: enum validation is case-sensitive against allowed values
checks.detail: log_level allowed ['DEBUG','INFO','WARN']; _coerce_enum matches the exact string (no lowering), raising ConfigValidationError for e.g. 'info'.

checks.requirement: string type used as-is; queue_url must be non-empty
checks.detail: _coerce_string keeps str values unchanged; queue_url spec sets non_empty=True and an empty string raises ConfigValidationError.

checks.requirement: Priority cascade cli_args > env_vars > config_file > defaults
checks.detail: load_config merges in order: defaults -> config_file -> env_vars (mapped by env name) -> cli_args (mapped by config key); cli_args wins over env over file over defaults.

checks.requirement: None means not-provided; empty string '' is provided and overridable by higher-priority non-None
checks.detail: Each merge step applies a value only when it is not None; empty string counts as provided and a higher-priority non-None value still overrides it.

checks.requirement: Unknown config-file keys ignored; missing config_file raises FileNotFoundError
checks.detail: config_file loop only applies keys present in the schema (unknown keys skipped); a non-existent config_file raises FileNotFoundError('Config file not found: ...').

checks.requirement: Validation errors must include the key name and the invalid value
checks.detail: ConfigValidationError messages include the key name and repr of the invalid value, e.g. "Invalid value for 'concurrency': ..."; unknown-key errors include the key name.

checks.requirement: Returned dict must contain all schema keys (defaults fill missing)
checks.detail: load_config returns {k: validate_value(k, merged[k]) for k in schema}, always emitting all 11 keys.

checks.requirement: API contract signatures must match spec
checks.detail: load_config(config_file=None, env_vars=None, cli_args=None), get_schema(), validate_value(key, value) — parameter order and defaults match spec; env_vars defaults to os.environ.
